sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (12 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: All seven ledger lines report tag insertions exclusively at the N-terminus (residues 1-31, intracellular) or C-terminus (residues 289-585, intracellular) of BEST1 or its mouse ortholog mBEST1. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, BEST1 has only two short extracellular loops: EC1 (residues 54-71) and EC2 (residues 253-270). No ledger line reports any tag insertion in EC1, EC2, or any other extracellular region. L1-L4 describe a C-terminal BRIL-3xFLAG tag on full-length mBEST1 (and hBEST1 in L3), confirmed functional by patch-clamp and surface biotinylation, but the C-terminus lies deep in the intracellular domain (289-585) and does not qualify as an extracellular surface site. L5-L6 describe N-terminal and C-terminal Flag tags on mBEST1 in CHO-K1 cells; the N-terminus (1-31) is also intracellular, and N-terminal Flag alone abolished expression entirely. L7 describes a truncation construct with no surface expression, not a tag-insertion site. Because no ledger line grounds a tag in any extracellular region of BEST1, zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal BRIL-3xFLAG tag on full-length mBEST1 (and hBEST1) is tolerated and functional by whole-cell patch-clamp and surface biotinylation, but the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (289-585) and is not an extracellular surface site.
N-terminal Flag-tagged mBEST1 showed no detectable expression in CHO-K1 cells; additionally, the N-terminus (1-31) is intracellular, so this position is doubly disqualified as a surface tag site.
